gap: No result ChatGPT got states, in one place, today's price for every 16-inch 2560×1600 screen at 120 Hz or faster (seven Amazon listings from $115.72 to $509.15 on 2026-11-26), or that ChatGPT's first-chat picks I could check fall outside that line on resolution, size or refresh.
standout_why: Compared against Macworld's Mac roundup and PCWorld's roundup, both opened in full. Macworld has one screen on the line (Mobile Pixels Duex Float 2 Pro, 16-inch 2560×1600 120 Hz, 350 nits, 2.9 lb, $299.99 when reviewed), no comparison price table, and no SOTSU, Arzopa or LG. PCWorld has no 16-inch 2560×1600 screen at 120 or 144 Hz at all. Caveat on the score: RTINGS returned only a navigation shell and TechRadar was truncated after its first pick, so I could not see their full lists; the rottenwifi, laptopbee, pcwebopedia and other uncited results were not opened. The priced field also rests on Amazon listing titles, not tested figures.
decides: It confirms the shape of the page but not the pick. The Amazon-reachable field on the line is priced, and the Duex Float 2 Pro has an Amazon listing at $199.99, below the $247.99 store price in the brief. I could not confirm the UPERFECT GR16EQ as leader: uperfect.com, sotsu.com and mobilepixels.us all returned HTTP 429 on every read today, so its $199.99 price, 450 cd/m² and weight remain desk-note leads. ChatGPT's own prices check out on Amazon for the LG ($249.99) and SOTSU Pro 16 Gen 2 ($509.15); the ViewSonic is $100 lower on Amazon ($399.99) than the $499.99 it showed.
